subject: spanish
topicDisplay: Context 3: School Life Studies & The World Of Work
promptStrong: Give me a 40-word writing task in Spanish on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, then mark my answer for accuracy and range.
promptWeak: Give me a two-way translation drill (Spanish↔English) on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, with answers and the common mistakes to avoid.

questions.q: What does “una entrevista de trabajo” mean?
questions.explain: “Una entrevista” = an interview, so “una entrevista de trabajo” = “a job interview”.

questions.q: How do you say “My dream is to become a lawyer”?
questions.explain: “Hacerse” = “to become” and “abogado” = “lawyer”, so “Mi sueño es hacerme abogado”.
'El desempleo' (also 'el paro') means 'unemployment'; 'el empleo' is 'employment/a job'.

questions.q: Which means “If I studied more, I would pass”?
How do you say “We aren't allowed to use mobiles in class”?
options: No se permite usar el móvil en clase
No se prohíbe usar el móvil en clase
No se permite usar el móvil en casa
Se permite usar el móvil en clase
questions.explain: “No se permite” = “it isn't allowed”, so “No se permite usar el móvil en clase”.

questions.q: Which sentence means “I would like to work abroad in the future”?
options: Me gusta trabajar en el extranjero en el futuro
Me gustaría trabajar en el extranjero en el futuro
Me gustaría trabajo en el extranjero en el futuro
Me gustaría trabajar en el extranjero en el pasado
questions.explain: “En el futuro” = in the future and “trabajar en el extranjero” = work abroad; “me gustaría” is the conditional.

questions.q: Which means “I would earn more money if I spoke languages”?
options: Ganaría más dinero si hablo idiomas
Ganaré más dinero si hablara idiomas
Ganaría más dinero si hablara idiomas
Gano más dinero si hablo idiomas
questions.explain: An unreal condition uses conditional + imperfect subjunctive: “ganaría... si hablara”.

questions.q: What does 'el billete de ida y vuelta' mean?
questions.explain: 'Ida y vuelta' means 'there and back', so 'el billete de ida y vuelta' = 'a return ticket'.
'El ocio' means 'leisure / free time'; it is a false friend with English 'office' (which is 'la oficina').

questions.q: How do you say 'I would like to be a nurse'?
questions.explain: 'Me gustaría' (conditional) = 'I would like' and 'enfermero' = 'nurse'; 'enfermo' means 'ill', a near-miss distractor.
“Las prácticas laborales” means “work experience / a work placement”.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'I have to revise for my exams'?
options: Tengo que repasar para mis exámenes
Tengo que faltar a mis exámenes
questions.explain: 'Repasar' means 'to revise' and 'tener que' = 'to have to', so this means 'I have to revise for my exams'.
